jobs.title: Program Manager, GTM Enablement
jobs.description:
The Role

At Doppel, we focus on building a culture where people feel respected, supported, and trusted to do meaningful work. We value clarity, collaboration, and solving real problems for our customers and teammates.

We are looking for a Program Manager, GTM Enablement to design and deliver impactful enablement programs that strengthen the performance of our go-to-market teams. In this role, you will partner with stakeholders across sales, customer success, partnerships, and marketing to identify capability gaps and build scalable learning programs that improve competency, retention, execution, and results across the organization.

What You Will Do

- Design and build scalable enablement programs that accelerate the performance and effectiveness of Doppel’s go-to-market teams.

- Partner with leaders and subject matter experts across sales, customer success, partnerships, and marketing to identify skill gaps and enablement opportunities.

- Translate business needs into structured learning programs, including curriculum, learning paths, and enablement resources.

- Build and manage programs within the company’s learning management system (LMS), ensuring content is accessible, engaging, and easy to navigate.

- Apply instructional design principles and adult learning best practices to create effective learning experiences.

- Manage enablement programs end-to-end, from needs assessment and program design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

- Track program engagement and effectiveness, using feedback and data to improve learning outcomes over time.

What We Are Looking For

- 5–7 years of experience in Sales or Technical Enablement

- Experience designing and delivering enablement programs that improve team performance.

- Strong instructional design and curriculum development skills.

- Experience owning and operating a learning management system (LMS).

- Strong program & project management skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.

- Experience working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

- A thoughtful, curious, and resourceful approach to problem solving.

Why Join Doppel

- $120,000-140,000 OTE

- Meaningful equity so you share in Doppel’s success

- Remote first culture with flexibility built in

- Flexible PTO, comprehensive health benefits, parental leave, and more

- A high growth environment where your work has immediate impact and visibility

Salary Range
$120,000 — $140,000 USD

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager - West
jobs.description:
The Role

At Doppel, we focus on building a culture where people feel respected, supported, and trusted to do meaningful work. We value clarity, collaboration, and solving real problems for our customers and teammates.

We are looking for a Enterprise Customer Success Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of high-growth customers, ensuring they achieve measurable value from Doppel’s platform. In this position, you will drive adoption, retention, and expansion while acting as a trusted advisor and advocate for your customers.

What You Will Do

- Own a portfolio of enterprise customers, building strong, trust-based relationships across stakeholders

- Guide customers through onboarding, adoption, and renewal to ensure consistent value realization

- Proactively monitor account health, identify risks early, and take action to mitigate churn

- Drive product adoption through training, enablement, and best practices

- Partner with Sales to identify and execute on upsell and expansion opportunities

- Lead customer conversations (including business reviews) that highlight impact, outcomes, and ROI

- Operate efficiently across a high-volume book of business using scalable processes and tools

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Operations to deliver a seamless customer experience

- Surface customer feedback and insights to influence product and operational improvements

What We Are Looking For

- 2–5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role in SaaS or cybersecurity

- Strong ability to manage multiple accounts while prioritizing effectively and driving outcomes

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Experience with startup/small companies that have a fast-moving, high-growth environment with evolving priorities

- Experience with data-driven decision making and account health tracking

Traits that set you apart:

- A proactive problem solver who identifies issues early and takes ownership to resolve them

- Leads by example—demonstrates accountability, follow-through, and a high standard of execution

- Resourceful and adaptable, able to navigate ambiguity and find solutions independently

- Customer-first mindset with a strong sense of urgency and bias toward action

- Curious and motivated to continuously learn and improve

Candidates must be authorized to work in the territory in which they're working. We are not currently able to sponsor visas.

$150,000 - $190,000 OTE

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodation during the application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, or to access the benefits and privileges of employment.

Salary Range
$150,000 — $190,000 USD

jobs.title: Regional Vice President of Sales - Enterprise, Northeast
jobs.description:
The Role

Doppel is seeking an experienced and results-driven Regional Vice President (RVP) of Sales to lead our Enterprise sales team across the Northeast region. This pivotal role requires a dynamic leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and is passionate about building high-performing sales teams. The RVP will be responsible for achieving regional revenue targets, driving strategic growth initiatives, developing top-tier sales talent, and ensuring forecasting rigor and predictability in the business.

What You Will Do

Team Leadership & Development

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives focused on new business and expansion within Enterprise accounts.

- Attract, hire, and retain top sales talent to build a high-performance team culture.

- Implement effective sales processes, forecast accuracy, and territory planning strategies.

Sales Strategy & Execution

- Define and execute the regional sales strategy in alignment with company goals.

- Analyze market dynamics, customer needs, and competitor activity to continuously refine sales tactics.

- Oversee pipeline development and ensure high-confidence forecasting accuracy to drive predictable revenue growth.

- Partner with channel and alliance organizations to co-sell, drive partner-sourced opportunities, and expand regional market coverage.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Sales Enablement,

- Channel, and Alliances to ensure alignment and support for regional priorities.

- Represent the voice of the customer to internal teams and influence product direction based on market feedback.

Performance Management

- Own and exceed regional revenue goals.

- Drive operational excellence by ensuring compliance with sales tools, CRM hygiene, and performance metrics.

- Establish and maintain a rigorous forecasting cadence, ensuring data-driven decisions and timely course corrections.

What We Are Looking For

- Experience: Minimum 3 years of sales leadership experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology-driven environment.

- Proven track record of exceeding team quotas and growing revenue within the Enterprise segment.

- Strong understanding of sales methodologies, forecasting processes, pipeline management, and operational discipline.

- Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain top-performing sales professionals.

- Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and data-driven decision-making skills.

- Prior experience managing geographically dispersed teams across large territories.

- Familiarity with selling into companies under $2.5B in revenue across various industries.

- Experience working with channel partners, resellers, and technology alliances to influence deal strategy and expand go-to-market reach.

- Deep understanding of enterprise software sales cycles and customer buying behavior in Enterprise.

Why Join Doppel

- The targeted compensation range for this role is between: $175,000 USD & $225,000 USD base, $350,000 & $450,000 OTE + equity.

- Meaningful equity so you share in Doppel’s success

- Remote first culture, must be living in territory.

- Flexible PTO, comprehensive health benefits, parental leave, and more

- A high growth environment where your work has immediate impact and visibility

Salary Range
$175,000 — $225,000 USD
